verdict.rationale: Devin's API lets users create sessions programmatically (including on behalf of other users) and set up scheduled recurring tasks, which could be scripted to process many tickets/items in sequence, and docs mention tackling Linear/Jira tickets. However there is no documented native 'bulk operation' or batch-processing endpoint/UI for acting on many items simultaneously, and community discussion raises concerns about reliability at scale (e.g., low issue-resolution rate). Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API endpoint or UI, first-party documentation of multi-item throughput, and independent evidence of successful bulk usage at scale.
